biggest_catch: All rates are 'up to' ceilings with no guaranteed floor - and Chicagoland residents are especially encouraged, so remote participants get the lower online/virtual rates.
catches: All stated rates are 'up to' ceilings, not guaranteed pay per study
In-lab studies pay the most ($21-28/hr) but require Chicagoland-area travel to Evanston or downtown Chicago campuses
Payment can be cash, VISA prepaid card, or Tango Card - form varies by study
Online studies cap at $16/hr; virtual studies at $17-21/hr - lower than in-lab
Study invitations come by email and availability varies; not on-demand work

payout_quote: In-lab studies compensate up to $21-28/hour for your time and effort. Payment may be in the form of cash, a VISA pre-paid card, or an electronic Tango Card, which is redeemable at many stores. We offer compensation for CTA travel and parking, when applicable. Online studies may compensate up to $16/hour, and virtual studies up to $17-21.

steps: Join the Kellogg Sona participant pool (anyone 18+)
Wait for study invitations by email or check for studies on the Sona site
Sign up for a study session or timeslot (online, virtual, or in-lab)
Complete the study (10-60 min: role-playing, surveys, games)
Receive compensation (cash, VISA prepaid card, or Tango Card); CTA travel/parking compensated when applicable
timing: Compensation provided at checkout after study completion; travel/parking reimbursed when applicable.
maximize: Official FAQ: compensation provided at checkout after the study. Fastest path: in-lab studies pay at checkout same-day — but in-lab is IN-PERSON. Online/virtual study payment timing is per-study and not stated. Blocker: this route bundles in-person lab studies with online ones; online timing undisclosed.
